title: Read a list item
summary: Groovy: Read a list item. Read pets[0]. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: A list stores ordered values. Its first position is zero. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Read a list item with Groovy

blocks.text: Install a JDK and Groovy. Save each example as lesson.groovy and run groovy lesson.groovy.
The list puts dog at index 1 because indexing starts at zero.
